scope: Exact medicines.org.uk/emc/product/<id>/smpc URLs in public.drugs.sources (read-only) plus static app citations. Titles fetched live. No database changes.
method: HTTP GET with retry on 429; <title> compared with associated slug and cited claim. Cited titles in DB are generic ('source for reviewed correction'), so formulation checks are flags, not automatic errors.
